changelog: Fixes repeated native sortBy parameters discarding the primary sort field. Follows committed Jellyfin sort settings even with cached results while preserving the selected item and per-library view choices.
description: Adds an accessible CoverFlow browser to Jellyfin Web for existing media libraries. It uses Jellyfin metadata and images without modifying library data.
name: CoverFlow
overview: Browse Jellyfin libraries with a 3D CoverFlow interface.
